claims: Brazil and France are playing an international friendly at Gillette Stadium in Foxboro, Massachusetts.
The match is on Thursday, March 26, 2026.
The match is at 4 p.m. ET.
The match will be streamed on ESPN+.
The match will be streamed on ESPN Deportes.
This is the first meeting between Brazil and France since 2015.
The match is part of a series of friendlies preparing for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Gillette Stadium is hosting matches, including a quarterfinal, for the 2026 FIFA World Cup later that summer.
Didier Deschamps is the head coach of France.
Didier Deschamps has brought a squad headlined by Kylian Mbappé.
Kylian Mbappé recently returned from injury.
Ousmane Dembélé is a Ballon d'Or winner.
Carlo Ancelotti is the head coach of Brazil.
The Brazilian roster includes on-loan Real Madrid forward Endrick Felipe.
Gabriel Sara is a new call-up for Brazil.
Igor Thiago is a new call-up for Brazil.
Rayan is a new call-up for Brazil.
Brazil won their last meeting against France 3-1 in 2015.
Tickets are available digitally through the Gillette Stadium App.
Free general parking is available on the opposite side of Route 1.
A strict clear-bag policy is in effect.
